name: LostMagic
description:
Welcome to LostMagic - a true role-playing game in the best traditions of the old school. Here you will come face to face with the secrets of a mysterious world where people from Earth came to fight for the remnants of magical energy. Join secret organizations, solve riddles and find fascinating Easter eggs.

In LostMagic, you will find an exciting combat system. Fight in turn-based battles, using many skills and talents. Study your opponents, understand their weaknesses and strengths to develop an effective strategy. The game features many dungeons that can be completed both alone and in a group of up to 5 people. Each dungeon is a separate challenge with unique bosses and valuable rewards. There are also PvP arenas for team battles and the "Tower of Arcana", where characters start the game without equipment and can win in different ways.

Unravel the secrets of the nameless City by penetrating its Inside Out. Pacify the Shaved Sisters gang. Become a warrior of the Swamp Legion or a paladin of the Last Order. Explore Area 51. Solve the riddles of Confluxion. Try on sneakers with stars - and go from December to June. In the world of LostMagic, there is no time to get bored and there is always something to do!
